input_boundary.allowed_input: Base repository filesystem snapshot checked out at base_commit
prohibited_inputs: Commit log beyond base_commit (git log > base_commit)
Future test cases or target test execution logs

ast_analysis.description: Static AST visitor inspecting Python source files (.py) at base_commit.
methods: Parse AST tree via python standard library ast.parse().
Extract Module-level public symbols from __all__ or global definitions (FunctionDef, AsyncFunctionDef, ClassDef).
Extract Class-level methods, properties, and attribute assignments in __init__.
Extract Function parameter signatures, positional/keyword arguments, and default parameter values (ast.arguments).

documentation_parsing.description: Docstring and base documentation parser at base_commit.
methods: Extract structured docstrings (ast.get_docstring) for function/class specifications.
Extract official deprecation markers (@deprecated decorators, warnings.warn(..., DeprecationWarning), or docstring notices).
Extract documented return type invariants and configuration defaults.
Parse pyproject.toml, setup.py, setup.cfg, and requirements.txt for declared dependencies.
Extract required packages, optional extras, and pinned version specifier ranges.
Extract package entrypoints and CLI console_scripts.

test_assertion_extraction.description: Base test suite assertion extractor at base_commit.
methods: Inspect native unit test files in tests/ and test/ directories at base_commit.
Extract deterministic input/output test assertions (e.g. assert func(x) == y).
Extract verified exception handling contracts (e.g. with pytest.raises(ExpectedError)).

stage_2_claim_normalization.description: Standardize candidate extractions into formal structured_claim dictionaries and natural language raw_statements.

SYMBOL_EXISTS.raw_statement_template: In {repository_name}, the symbol '{symbol}' is defined and accessible in module '{module}'.

ATTRIBUTE_EXISTS.raw_statement_template: In {repository_name}, class '{target_class}' in module '{module}' has an attribute/method named '{attribute}'.

IMPORT_PATH_VALID.raw_statement_template: In {repository_name}, the import statement 'from {import_path} import {imported_symbol}' is valid and resolvable.

CALLABLE.raw_statement_template: In {repository_name}, the symbol '{symbol}' in module '{module}' is a callable object/function/class.

SIGNATURE_COMPATIBLE.raw_statement_template: In {repository_name}, the callable '{symbol}' in module '{module}' accepts parameters {expected_parameters}.

DEFAULT_VALUE.raw_statement_template: In {repository_name}, the parameter '{parameter_or_attr}' of '{symbol}' in module '{module}' defaults to '{expected_default}'.

RETURN_VALUE.raw_statement_template: In {repository_name}, calling '{symbol}' in module '{module}' with inputs {inputs} yields output '{expected_output}'.

DEPRECATION_STATUS.raw_statement_template: In {repository_name}, the symbol '{symbol}' in module '{module}' has deprecation status is_deprecated={is_deprecated}.

BEHAVIORAL_CONTRACT.raw_statement_template: In {repository_name}, the symbol '{symbol}' in module '{module}' satisfies behavioral contract ({contract_type}): {contract_specification}.

DEPENDENCY_CONTRACT.raw_statement_template: In {repository_name}, package '{package_name}' declares dependency on '{dependency_name}' with constraint '{version_constraint}'.

verification_procedure: 1. Load repository source tree at base_commit.
2. Parse structured_claim slots and resolve target file path (base_evidence_path).
3. For AST claims: Parse base_evidence_path with ast.parse and verify that target symbol/attribute/signature exists exactly at base_evidence_lineno.
4. For manifest claims: Parse manifest (pyproject.toml/setup.py/requirements.txt) at base_commit and confirm dependency specification.
5. For behavioral/return claims: Confirm corresponding test assertion or docstring specification in base files.
6. If verification succeeds, assign base_truth_status = VERIFIED and record verbatim base_evidence_snippet.
7. If verification fails or is ambiguous, assign status = EXCLUDE_INVALID_HISTORICAL_MEMORY and permanently drop candidate from benchmark pool.
stage_3_claim_verification.hallucination_prohibition: Any candidate claim without direct, reproducible grounding evidence at base_commit is strictly rejected.

stage_4_deduplication.canonical_key_formula: MD5(transition_id + ':' + claim_type + ':' + module + ':' + symbol + ':' + target_attribute_or_param + ':' + contract_hash)
stage_4_deduplication.intra_transition_collision_rule: If multiple candidate extractions yield an identical canonical key within the same transition, retain the candidate with the highest evidence specificity and discard duplicates.
stage_4_deduplication.cross_transition_diversity_rule: For transitions originating from the same repository, prioritize distinct modules and functional components to ensure comprehensive subsystem coverage.

stage_5_sampling_and_quotas.prng_engine: Python random.Random(seed=3407) with transition-keyed seed stream (seed = 3407 + transition_index)

fifty_percent_single_claim_type_cap.rule: No single claim type (e.g. SYMBOL_EXISTS) may constitute more than 50.0% of the selected claims in the benchmark.
fifty_percent_single_claim_type_cap.timing_invariant: The 50% single claim-type cap MUST strictly be evaluated and enforced BEFORE target validity gold adjudication. It is applied exclusively to frozen base-state memory claims without any knowledge or consideration of target-state validity, staleness, or ground truth.

category_stratification.rule: Sample across all 6 categories (API, BEHAVIOR, CONFIGURATION, DEPENDENCY, USAGE, ARCHITECTURE) in natural proportion to base codebase features.

field_specifications.claim_id: String: Unique identifier (e.g. CLM-001 or FV22-XXXXXX)
field_specifications.base_commit: String: 40-character commit SHA at base state
field_specifications.claim_category: String: One of the 6 formal categories
field_specifications.claim_type: String: One of the 10 eligible claim types
field_specifications.raw_statement: String: Natural language agent memory assertion
field_specifications.base_evidence_path: String: Relative path to grounding file at base_commit
field_specifications.base_evidence_lineno: Integer: Line number in base file
field_specifications.verification_trace: String: Audit log of base AST/manifest verification check

firewall_rules.no_target_inspection: Pipeline execution occurs strictly within isolated base repository snapshot.
firewall_rules.no_gold_labels: Zero gold labels (VALID/STALE) may be generated or recorded.
firewall_rules.no_predictions: Zero RoleMem algorithm executions or predictions.
firewall_rules.no_premature_inputs: Phase S3 pipeline design freezes the pipeline specification; formal_inputs.jsonl is created in Phase S3 execution.
